en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a cobblestone street lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops. Horse‑drawn carts and pedestrians appear along the street. In the distance a large church tower with a distinctive spire dominates the skyline. The caption at the top reads "Grossenhain. Naundorferstrasse." Additional German business signage is visible on the right‑hand buildings.
